'''"Deathfire" McDibbs''' was a pilot of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], McDibbs held the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and piloted a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
McDibbs appeared appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Lieutenant "Deathfire" McDibbs was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
